extracted.intended_audience: inventors and patent applicants, IP practitioners, and patent office staff preparing or advising on PCT (international) filings
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and training material covering the procedural steps, options, and formal requirements for filing an international patent application under the PCT system. Includes topics from initial filing through national phase, searches, examinations, fees, and special disclosure/sequence rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Main procedural steps in the PCT system
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduces the main procedural steps in the PCT system; discusses traditional patent systems; territoriality and patents; options available for international patent protection; and the advantages of using the PCT for international patent filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented in the video episode as an overview; the page itself summarizes topics but provides no detailed procedural steps in text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to the PCT System
rubrics_metrics.description: General introduction to what the PCT system is and how it functions as an international patent filing route.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic covered in the Learn the PCT video series; no further textual detail on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basics of the PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamental concepts and baseline knowledge required to use the PCT system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covered in the video series; page lists as a distinct training topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for filing an international (PCT) application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core topic; detailed filing requirements (forms, timing, content) are implied as the subject of the video/training material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declarations under Rule 4.17
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and effects of declarations made under PCT Rule 4.17.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page lists the topic title; specifics of Rule 4.17 are not reproduced on this page but are indicated as covered by the training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation of PCT Applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance about who may represent applicants before the PCT/receiving offices and how representation should be indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a training topic; the page does not include the detailed representation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority Claims and Priority Documents

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a topic in the video series; the page does not provide the textual details of claiming priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction/Addition of Priority Claims

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not expanded on the page beyond being a listed training item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by Reference

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a topic; detailed examples and limits on incorporation are not shown on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rectification of Obvious Mistakes

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned as a training subject; specifics would be in the video or other PCT guidance.
